data.name: Leyla In Veil
data.detailed_description:
Game Overview

This is an HD-2D pixel-style side-scrolling action shooter survival horror game. Players will take on the role of Laila, a senior agent from a mysterious organization, partnering with her companion Flora to investigate a bizarre art gallery.

Story Background

This is a world filled with anomalies and distortions.

The Istvi Art Gallery was built 2 years ago, reportedly constructed by an entrepreneur to commemorate his late artist wife. According to reports, this remote gallery was established by the entrepreneur in memory of his wife.

Half a month ago, a supernatural incident occurred, resulting in multiple mysterious disappearances. Informed sources claim that everyone inside the gallery vanished without a trace overnight. Following the incident, local police immediately sealed off the gallery and dispatched an investigation team. Two hours later, the captain dragged two team members' corpses out through the back door, while the remaining survivors suffered mental breakdowns and could not recall their experiences inside.

Leyla and Flora, agents from a mysterious organization, are dispatched to investigate this eerie event...

Gameplay

Action and Progression
The core gameplay revolves around action shooting. Players control Laila as she enters the gallery to investigate and battles various grotesque monsters.

Different monsters have unique characteristics and attack patterns—some even possess multiple attack methods or defensive abilities.

In addition to collecting various firearms for shooting combat, players can use melee techniques, parries, and other moves to fight enemies.

When swarmed by hordes of monsters, devise strategies on the fly, carve a bloody path, and revel in the intense, thrilling side-scrolling action!

Weapon Upgrades

Use in-game resources to upgrade different weapons, enhancing their performance. Each weapon has unique upgrade traits, and fully upgrading them unlocks hidden effects.

Collect weapons diligently, max them out, and unleash devastation on the monsters!

Resource Management

Players must carefully manage backpack capacity—different items occupy varying weights. Strategically acquire and discard resources for optimal gameplay.

Random Elements and Exploration
Progress through levels by following the story, scavenging for ammo, medicine, crafting materials, and more.

Along the way, encounter various obstacles—solve these simple puzzles with clever thinking.

For complex routes, consult the map to find your way.

Story Progression

Players control Laila as she investigates the eerie art gallery, uncovering the events that transpired within and the conspiracy lurking behind it...

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows10 or Windows11
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-2300 or AMD FX-4350
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTS 450 (1GB) or AMD Radeon HD 6570 (1GB)
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows10 or Windows11
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-3470 or AMD FX-6300
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 760 (2GB) or AMD Radeon HD 7870 (2GB)
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Headphones recommended
